summary: Added per-team and per-project unread navigation lights for incoming member, chat, decision, activity, calendar, and task updates. Current-user aliases are excluded, opening a view clears its unread state, and polling detects synchronized changes. Collaboration state now uses Git-trackable collaboration paths while legacy hidden files remain readable; canonical event files received through Git are reconciled into the local index.
follow_ups: Human-review the pending receipt before promoting it to canonical shared knowledge.
